featured_reviews.name: Jitendra Meshram
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had a very bad experience with Heena Digital Photo Studio, which is why I’m giving them a 1-star rating.

I had ordered two 20x30 cm family photos with frames from Heena Photo Studio, Chembur. One of the frames had a small gap on the top side that needed minor repair. When I pointed it out, their response was, “We won’t repair it; if you want, you can take a full refund.”

I repeatedly requested them to fix it, but they refused, saying that after repair I might again find some fault and that this would go on forever. Such a negative and unprofessional attitude is disappointing.

I had also given them another photo order, but they refused to take that as well. I have never had such a poor experience before. They completely lack professionalism and do not know how to take customer feedback positively.

Despite my repeated requests, they kept saying, “We’ll refund your money, please get the work done from another studio.”
Is this how you treat a customer? They are literally avoiding customers instead of resolving the issue.

I was ready to give them more business with two big frames, but they refused to work. Totally hopeless service.

featured_reviews.review_text: We gave order for one family photo frame after the final product was ready, it had some issues so we asked the studio to return the photo frame with corrections and they were minor correction like frame was not perfectly fit into the photo, there was some gap between frame and photo, but they refuse to do the same, though they gave back our money to us, but they refused to make the corrections, and they also refused to take another order from us, so technically they made us feel like we are banned from their studio.

featured_reviews.name: Himanshi Bajaj
featured_reviews.review_text:
I don’t usually write long reviews, but this team deserves every word. I have never experienced this level of ease and peace of mind with any team that feels like family, before. Dhruv and Sourabh led an absolutely amazing team-experienced, prepared, and so deeply tuned in to every moment that mattered.

They didn’t just take photos; they made sure we lived our moments too. They would literally push my parents to step out of their Marwadi hospitality mode and actually enjoy their own celebration. They guided my CA couple to pose (which is honestly a task in itself!), and they did it with so much patience, warmth, and humour.

What touched me the most was how invested they were. I would have to force them to go eat because they were so focused on capturing everything perfectly. From late nights to early mornings, they showed up with the same energy, the same dedication, and the same big-hearted enthusiasm.

Their work ethic, their vibe, their passion — everything is admirable. My entire family is genuinely grateful that they were part of our celebration. They didn’t just capture our memories… they became a beautiful part of them.

Highly, highly recommended.
